shared_elements: rows of writing arranged in parallel lines
ruled framing lines bounding a field of signs
straight-line geometric marks on a flat wall surface
justification: Both surfaces depict nothing but abstract incised sign-writing: rows of angular script-like characters set out along ruled guidelines within a bounded field, which is a reasonably specific shared scheme. They differ in that A is a single monumental block of many long horizontal text lines filling a formal rectangular panel, while B is a scattered informal assemblage of crosshatched lattices, circles and a narrow vertical column of signs, with no unified text field.
